topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides introductory framing and outlines the lecture's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition via PAMPs, DAMPs, and PRRs
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the innate immune system detects microbial infection and tissue damage through pattern recognition receptors and their intracellular signaling platforms.

topics.label: Inflammatory response, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the cellular and physiological events that drive inflammation, including sentinel cell signaling, leukocyte extravasation, lymphatic drainage, and severe systemic reactions.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the mechanisms responsible for shutting down inflammation, repairing damaged tissue, and managing chronic or persistent inflammatory states.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing framing for the lecture and previews the subsequent lecture topic.
